name: Prestige - SEO Baseline Audit 2026-08-12
body:
> Audit · Prestige · 2026-08-12

Versions: the same audit also exists as `SEO-Baseline-Audit-2026-08-12.docx`, a formatted Word copy. The `~$` lock file next to it is ignored.

# Summary
This is the official SEO baseline for prestigeplumbingsc.com. It covers all 41 sitemap URLs, using GSC data from the Domain property (last 3 months, about Jul 2 to Aug 9, 2026; indexing snapshot 8/7/26) and a live crawl on 2026-08-12. Future audits compare against these values and the file says not to reset it unless told to. It has one row per URL: indexed status, primary keyword, intent, title, H1, word count, quality, clicks and impressions, main issue, priority and action.

# Property baseline
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Clicks | 25 |
| Impressions | 1,270 |
| CTR | 2% |
| Avg position | 16 |
| Ranking queries | 149 |
| Indexed | 21 of 41 |
| Top branded query | "prestige plumbing" (4 clicks, 22 impr) |
| Top opportunity | "sump pump installation" (0 clicks, 94 impr, no page) |

# Key findings
- All 41 URLs are technically healthy: 200, HTTPS, self-canonical, no noindex, valid schema.
- The 6 city pages and the `/services/` and `/service-areas/` hubs were not indexed and had zero visibility. This is the biggest ceiling. The site is young (GSC crawl history starts about July 8), so the cause is discovery lag, not a technical block.
- An `http://` homepage was indexed separately (442 impr) alongside the https one (492 impr).
- Both hubs are thin (248 and 179 words).
- The city pages are genuinely unique (42 to 48% pairwise similarity, each with a local intro and 3 city FAQs). The audit says to protect this.
- No high cannibalization. Watch the water-bill trio (hidden leak pillar, meter check, summer bill spike) and the hard-water pair.
- Metadata trims: long titles on main-sewer-line (76), drain-smells (71) and chemical-cleaners (65); long metas on slab-leak, signs-of-hard-water and low-water-pressure; an em dash in the water-softener meta.

# Update log in the file (2026-08-12)
- The city URL flatten was deployed live (find and replace across 42 files, folders moved, sitemap updated and resubmitted, backup taken first).
- Indexing was requested for the hubs and the OLD city URLs, which now 404. The new city URLs still needed requests (blocked that day by the GSC daily cap).
- The NameHero disk-quota blocker was confirmed resolved.

# Top 5 actions (as ranked in the file)
1. Get the 6 city pages and 2 hubs indexed, and add in-body links to them.
2. Fix the http/https homepage duplicate with a clean 301.
3. Thicken the two hubs with intro copy and an FAQ ([Prestige - Hub Content Draft 2026-08-12](lib:brain-prestige-hub-content-draft-2026-08-12)).
4. Create a sump pump service page or blog post.
5. Run a CTR pass on water-filtration (206 impr) and sewer-camera-inspection (85 impr), and trim the long titles.
